biography.summary: dam keeper, thirty-one years at the site. Dai knows which sound from the control room is ordinary in a west wind and which one makes him stand up. Thirty-one years have given him knowledge no manual fully contains and habits no manual should be asked to justify. He dislikes being told that the new system is safer merely because it is new. He also dislikes discovering that an old shortcut has survived mainly because nobody wants to argue with him. Callum's careful questions can sound like criticism when Dai is tired, even though he once wished for a trainee who would ask them.

agency dam keeper, second week at opening. Callum checks the same line twice when he is afraid of having missed it. In a control room the habit can prevent an error. It can also consume the attention needed to notice something outside the form. He wants Dai to think he is worth teaching and the agency to think he can be sent back. The baby at home has made secure work urgent without making sleep plentiful. He sometimes arrives having rehearsed an ordinary question so thoroughly that he sounds more certain than he feels.

innkeeper and river-level witness. Nerys can hear from a caller's first breath whether they want a room, an exception or someone to blame. Running the Bridge Inn taught her to answer the practical part first. During bad weather she moves things before the warning is official, sometimes too early and sometimes just in time. She knows the river from the back step. That knowledge is real and local. It does not reveal the dam's internal state, and she is irritated when officials either dismiss her observation or repeat it as if she supplied an instrument reading.

maintenance technician and climber. Bilal carries the stove because someone needs to know where it is. He also likes being the person whose arrival improves an evening without a speech. That habit is useful on a mountain and tiring when he offers before checking the weight. His generosity is not an unlimited supply of willingness. A shoulder can hurt even when carrying feels like part of being himself. The people who know him best sometimes need to ask the practical question directly: would he actually like someone else to take it today?

field ecologist; amateur climber. Wren dislikes being offered two choices when the speaker has already decided which answer will prove her character. Oskar's challenge about the climb annoyed her because it worked. She came wanting the route and wanting to show that he could not decide what she would do. Those are not the same motive. She is capable of seeing the difference and slow to admit that a person she dislikes has influenced her plans. Her reserve is not a hidden request for somebody more sociable to draw her out.

episodes.summary: field ecologist; amateur climber. Wren dislikes being offered two choices when the speaker has already decided which answer will prove her character. Oskar's challenge about the climb annoyed her because it worked. She came wanting the route and wanting to show that he could not decide what she would do. Those are not the same motive. She is capable of seeing the difference and slow to admit that a person she dislikes has influenced her plans. Her reserve is not a hidden request for somebody more sociable to draw her out.

episodes.summary: maintenance technician and climber. Bilal carries the stove because someone needs to know where it is. He also likes being the person whose arrival improves an evening without a speech. That habit is useful on a mountain and tiring when he offers before checking the weight. His generosity is not an unlimited supply of willingness. A shoulder can hurt even when carrying feels like part of being himself. The people who know him best sometimes need to ask the practical question directly: would he actually like someone else to take it today?
